data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior year reserve strengthening driven by back-year deterioration: gross cumulative incurred claims for the 2019 underwriting year increased (from the prior diagonal) producing an aggregate gross prior-year reserve strengthening of approximately $13.5m. The annual report also notes a net deterioration of $5.306m (net of reinsurance) in prior year reserves and attributes the movement to changes in reserving assumptions and margins incorporated into the reserving approach (IBNR recalibration and methodology updates). The movement primarily affects the motor/automotive casualty portfolio written through the ibott Rover class.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).

the implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account, which together with margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on a GAAP basis
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) at 1 Jan 2021. There is no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note; the report gives a net prior-year deterioration ($5,306k) but not a gross prior-year movement. Gross prior-year development was therefore calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) by comparing the 2019 current estimate to its previous diagonal (One year later  Two years later). Amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) though field names include _gbp_m. Line-of-business allocation is inferred from narrative (automotive casualty/ibott Rover) rather than explicitly quantified by LOB in the movement notes.
